name: tianshu-ordering
description: 天枢点单 - 多商户扫码点单 SaaS（小程序 + 管理后台 + API）

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @tianshu/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tianshu/admin
scripts.dev:h5: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tianshu/h5
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tianshu/api && npm run build -w @tianshu/admin && npm run build -w @tianshu/h5
